conclusion.summary: Reducing the legacy 1.95 proxy floor to measured maximum-normal/Kn ratios with the original 1.05 guard is insufficient for native solver recovery in these six local searches. Persistent native eta/root-Mach/LM screens and local convergence remain; actual source bounds were never relaxed. Two terminal geometries pass all final native gas checks after real evaluate and full radial solution, despite failing stricter native search screens. These are recoupling seeds only.
conclusion.uncertainty: Finite local starts cannot distinguish a missed basin from incompatibility of the unchanged screens; measured stress/Kn ratios are geometry-specific and cannot certify new contours.

reproduction.source_loading: Register a ModuleType in sys.modules; execute vinogradov.course_adapter.SOURCE_CELLS except42 from source notebook, in order; no original coupled solve.
reproduction.attempts: For each saved input_geometry/input_config, convert phi/psi to tuples and construct source Config. Call source resource_geometry_refinement(input_geometry,cfg,STRENGTH_REQUIREMENTS,stress_factors=...,maxiter=220).
reproduction.diagnostics: A read-only sys.setprofile return-event hook snapshots native resource_geometry_refinement frame locals even on the Bad exception; captures source solution,x,seed,bounds,result,cons,power,temperatures. No optimizer/function mathematics are patched.
reproduction.true_power: For each terminal x construct cfg with x[8:10] reactions and saved frozen phi/psi; call native evaluate(x[:7],cfg), native design_checks, balances, stator_radial_screen and radial_stage(...,alpha_const,points=101); compare exact source cell74 radial assertions.
reproduction.stress_proxy: Original geometry: maximum actual sigma_normal_max_MPa over BOTH source strength methods and all sections for each rotor / native source stage sigma_MPa; multiply by existing1.05 guard. The sole changed argument is stress_factors, not physical checks or source code.
reproduction.analysis_code: All scientific code was inline; no throwaway script was created.

native_annulus_necessary_bound_followup.meaning: Necessary lower bound only; pass is not actual blade acceptance. Independent of Z, blade scale and 1.95 proxy; original monotone-area/taper assumptions and source 0.5% tolerance retained.

native_annulus_necessary_bound_followup.interpretation: Both recovered gas-only seeds pass the unchanged native necessary annulus CF/LM bound for both rotors at target root/tip area ratio1.6 (source tolerance ratio_max1.608). This bound does not reject either gas seed before profile selection. It does not establish that actual profiles can realize the lower tension bound or meet300MPa/LM1.2 with bending and all geometry/capacity constraints.
